links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-5 patient answers (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Reading Ease) on DDH and PAO
links.effect: Readability metrics scored 5.0 ± 0.0 and clarity 4.98 ± 0.10; authors conclude responses were readable. Grade-level values are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Mean scores were highest for relevance (5.0 ± 0.0), clarity (4.98 ± 0.10), and readability metrics (5.0 ± 0.0).

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM's accuracy, clarity, and safety in generating answers to patient questions on DDH and PAO, but does not compare outcomes with and without an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
